title: Hotel king bed · original Blender model
author: the internet slop warehouse
description: Original CC0 hotel king bed built by script in Blender 4.0 (projects/roadside-inn/blender/bed.py): upholstered box spring on walnut feet, beveled mattress, cloth-simulated duvet and navy bed scarf, turned-down sheet, four puffy pillows in two rows. 1.93 x 2.03 m, origin at floor center, head toward -Z, Y up. ~64k triangles; Poly Haven cotton/walnut maps (CC0).
